                                                                                                                                                                             Power sequencing


         Novena PVT2-A
A                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   A




B                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   B




    I2C mappings:
    addresses are already shifted left by one to accommodate r/w bit
    i.e., address is expressed as the write address
    I2C1: 10k pull-up
           SMBus functions (optional)                                                                                                P1.8V_SW4 has option to power VTT
           MMA8452 (0x38) (optional)                                                                             Use this option to lower VTT source to 1.0V to save power
           SO-DIMM identification (0xA0)
           FPGA (optional)
           SO-DIMM temp sensor (0x30) (optional)
           STMPE610 (0x88) (optional)
           Gas gauge and charger via SMB (on battery board)
           PCF8523 RTC (0xD0)

    I2C2: 1.8k pull-up
         HDMI DDC (0xA0, 0x74)
         expansion header                                                                                                       changes on table:
C        FPGA (optional)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            C
         PMIC (0x10)                                                                                                               P1.8V_VGEN3 micbias gen option
                                                                                                                                   (reprogram to 3.0V before using)
    I2C3: 2.2k pull-up
         LCD EDID (0xA0)
         ES8283 (0x22)
         FPGA (optional)
         Utility EEPROM (0xAC)
